item.title: Middle East Eye: US re-issues security warnings to citizens in Bahrain, Saudi Arabia
item.description: US re-issues security warnings to citizens in Bahrain, Saudi Arabia The US State Department re-issued its security alerts to American citizens in Saudi Arabia and Bahrain on Wednesday. The warnings were last sent late in October, and call for "heightened vigilance" in both Gulf countries following attacks from Iran and Yemen's Houthis over the last few days.

item.title: Middle East Eye: Israeli defence minister says Israel will indefinitely occupy Gaza, Lebanon, Syria
